origin.text: The results are ___ with the national survey.

prompt.es: Escribe la sección de resultados con tres conectores, una fuente y dos matices.

answer.text: The survey was completed by 150 students. The main findings show that 60 percent of respondents sleep fewer than eight hours. Furthermore, the percentage is higher in the final year, where it reaches 70 percent. Only a minority of students, 18 percent, use a phone after midnight; nevertheless, this group reports the worst sleep. It appears that late phone use may be linked to poor sleep, although the survey cannot prove this. These results are consistent with the national survey, which stated that teenagers sleep too little. Therefore, the school may wish to consider a later start. Notably, the students who sleep least tend to be the most tired in class. More research is needed to confirm these findings.
accepted: The survey was completed by 150 students. The main findings show that 60 percent of respondents sleep fewer than eight hours. Furthermore, the percentage is higher in the final year, where it reaches 70 percent. Only a minority of students, 18 percent, use a phone after midnight; nevertheless, this group reports the worst sleep. It appears that late phone use may be linked to poor sleep, although the survey cannot prove this. These results are consistent with the national survey, which stated that teenagers sleep too little. Therefore, the school may wish to consider a later start. Notably, the students who sleep least tend to be the most tired in class. More research is needed to confirm these findings.

According to the survey of 150 students, 60 percent sleep fewer than eight hours, and the figure rises to 70 percent in the final year. Moreover, a minority of respondents, 18 percent, use a phone after midnight; however, they report the worst sleep. There is some evidence that phones may affect sleep, but the data do not show that they are the cause. The findings are consistent with the national survey, which stated that teenagers do not sleep enough. Therefore, it is recommended that the school should consider a later start. Notably, tired students tend to concentrate less in class. The percentage of students affected could be higher in other schools.

feedback.es: La sección combina cifras, tres conectores formales, una fuente y al menos dos afirmaciones matizadas (it appears that, may, tend to).

origin.text: Encuesta escolar sobre el sueño (150 estudiantes): el 60 % duerme menos de ocho horas; en último curso, el 70 %; el 18 % usa el móvil después de medianoche y duerme peor. La encuesta nacional afirma que los adolescentes duermen poco. Escribe entre 110 y 180 palabras: tres conectores formales (furthermore, nevertheless, therefore…), la fuente y dos afirmaciones matizadas.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal y matizada del hallazgo sobre el uso del móvil.

choices.text: The 18 percent use a phone after midnight and sleeps worse, so the phone is the cause.
I think phones are terrible because 18 percent use them at night.
Eighteen percent of respondents use a phone after midnight and appear to sleep worse.

feedback.es: Appear to sleep worse es prudente y neutro; las otras versiones afirman una causa o usan un tono personal.
